About Kestrel Freight

Kestrel Freight was founded in 2019 in Amsterdam by two former freight forwarders who were tired of tracking shipments in spreadsheets.

Today we are a team of 240 people across Amsterdam, Lyon and Chicago. We sell our platform to logistics and supply chain teams at manufacturers, distributors and retailers.

Leadership

  • Marta Visser, Chief Executive Officer and co-founder
  • Jonas de Wit, Chief Technology Officer and co-founder
  • Hannah Okafor, Chief Revenue Officer, joined in January 2026 to build out our go-to-market team in North America
